PATIENT: Priya Sharma | ID: PAT-1001 | EXAM: OPG (2026-06-12)
CLINICAL INDICATION: Pre-treatment evaluation of third molars and baseline dental screening.
TECHNIQUE: Standard digital panoramic radiograph.
FINDINGS: Tooth 48 is partially erupted with mesioangular impaction; root apices are located approximately 1.5 mm from the superior cortical margin of the inferior alveolar nerve canal. Tooth 38 is partially erupted with vertical alignment. Coronal radiolucency is noted on the occlusal surface of tooth 16 penetrating into mid-dentin. No periapical radiolucencies are observed. Alveolar bone crest heights are preserved bilaterally. Both maxillary sinuses are clear.
IMPRESSION: Mesioangular impaction of tooth 48; partially erupted tooth 38; coronal caries tooth 16.
RECOMMENDATION: Restorative therapy for tooth 16. CBCT imaging advised prior to surgical removal of tooth 48 to assess nerve relationship.

findings.observation: Intact enamel and dentinal contours. No coronal radiolucency or deep fissure defect identified.

Slight horizontal overlap at the mesial contact with tooth 24 limits complete interproximal enamel assessment.

impression: No radiographic evidence of periapical pathosis or gross dental caries associated with tooth 25.
reports.recommendation: Perform clinical thermal sensibility and electric pulp testing. Check for cervical abrasion or exposed root dentin.
